title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for fast on-device agents
summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24-billion parameter language model specifically optimized for fast on-device AI agents. The model is designed to run locally on devices like smartphones and edge devices, enabling low-latency, privacy-preserving agentic applications without cloud dependency.
problem_solved: Enables efficient execution of AI agents directly on local devices with low latency and without internet connectivity, while preserving user privacy.
why_valuable: Makes AI agent capabilities accessible on consumer hardware with fast inference speeds, reducing cloud costs and addressing privacy concerns for real-time agentic applications.
